'''Thorsgild''' was a celestial body<ref name="Politics" /> located in the [[Thorsgild system/Legends|Thorsgild system]], a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Meerian sector/Legends|Meerian sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> By some point between [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]] and [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{ThePoliticsOfContrabandDate|Easy Money}}</ref> the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] that the individual [[Simms Jonndril]] called the "[[Blood Bucket]]" was a favorite establishment of his on Thorsgild, and he eventually told about it to a group of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].<ref name="Politics" />

==Behind the scenes==
Thorsgild was mentioned in "[[Easy Money]]," a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure written by [[Eric S. Trautmann]] and published in the [[1992]] [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement ''[[The Politics of Contraband]]''.<ref name="Politics" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Thorsgild [[Star system/Legends|system]], and thereby Thorsgild itself, in grid square N-7.<ref name="EAOC" />
